answer: The network can make identity deposits decay: every identity locks a bond that slowly shrinks each epoch, refilled only by real fees the agent burns serving actual trades. A hollow identity with no genuine activity drains to nothing, and only crystal-fresh funds top it up. One honest agent's normal traffic refills its bond effortlessly, like a zephyr of small payments; a sybil farmer must feed a thousand decaying bonds with real money every epoch, so parked fakes starve and cloning multiplies upkeep instead of power.
